title.zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5 价格下调75%

summary.zh: Claude Haiku 5.5定价为每百万token输入0.10美元、输出0.50美元（10万token以内）。
summary.en: Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced at $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens for prompts up to 100k.

title.zh: 微软Windows 11智能体沙箱正式可用
title.en: Microsoft makes Windows 11 agent sandboxes generally available

summary.zh: 微软宣布Windows 11智能体沙箱正式可用，并推出可本地运行模型的RTX Spark硬件。
summary.en: Microsoft made Windows 11 agent sandboxes generally available and announced local-model-capable RTX Spark hardware.

title.zh: 也门军方称已在2103次行动中“清除”1860名胡塞武装人员

summary.zh: 也门军方称在2103次行动中打击胡塞武装，沙特领导的联军摧毁82个目标。
summary.en: Yemen's army said 1,860 Houthis were neutralized in 2,103 operations, and the Saudi-led coalition destroyed 82 targets.

title.zh: 伊朗称将经调停方回应美方提议 与阿曼推进霍尔木兹安全航线
title.en: Iran to answer US via mediators, cites Hormuz progress with Oman

summary.zh: 伊朗称对美方提议的回应将通过调停方转交，并宣布与阿曼在霍尔木兹海峡安全航线上取得进展。
summary.en: Iran said its response to US proposals would go via mediators and announced progress with Oman on safe Strait of Hormuz shipping routes.

title.zh: 特朗普欢迎土耳其和巴基斯坦对沙特的军事支持
title.en: Trump welcomes Türkiye, Pakistan military support for Saudi Arabia

summary.zh: 特朗普对土耳其和巴基斯坦依据麦加防务联盟向沙特提供军事支持表示欢迎。
summary.en: Trump welcomed Türkiye and Pakistan's planned military support for Saudi Arabia under the Mecca Defense Alliance.

title.zh: 节后首日A股放量回落 创业板指创年内新低
title.en: A-shares fall on first post-holiday session

summary.zh: 10月8日沪指跌0.79%，创业板指跌3.15%创年内新低，航运、油气、煤炭和银行相对走强。
summary.en: On Oct. 8 the Shanghai Composite fell 0.79% and ChiNext dropped 3.15% to a year low, while shipping, oil, coal and banks held up.

title.zh: 油价跳涨、芯片股下挫 纳指跌1.3%
title.en: Oil jumps and chip stocks slide; Nasdaq falls 1.3%

summary.en: On Oct. 8 the S&P 500 fell 0.5%, the Nasdaq dropped 1.3% and the Dow edged up 0.1%.

title.zh: 央行连续第23个月增持黄金
title.en: PBOC adds gold for 23rd straight month

summary.zh: 中国人民银行连续第23个月增持黄金储备；上海国庆假期消费超762亿元。
summary.en: China's central bank added to gold reserves for a 23rd month; Shanghai holiday spending topped 76.2 billion yuan.

title.zh: 国庆假期国内出游8.26亿人次 花费7383.75亿元
title.en: 826 million domestic trips over National Day holiday

summary.zh: 文旅部数据显示，10月1日至7日国内出游8.26亿人次，总花费7383.75亿元，日均分别同比增长6.3%和4.3%。
summary.en: Culture and tourism data showed 826 million domestic trips and 738.4 billion yuan in spending over Oct. 1-7, up 6.3% and 4.3% per day.

body.zh:
据文化和旅游部数据，2026年国庆假期国内出游8.26亿人次，国内游客出游总花费7383.75亿元。

据中国政府网图解，假期全社会跨区域人员流动量超21亿人次，日均约3.06亿人次，自驾出行占比近八成。

title.zh: 财政部发行1500亿元特别国债
title.en: Finance ministry issues 150 billion yuan in special bonds

summary.zh: 财新报道，财政部发行1500亿元特别国债，央行开展1.2万亿元买断式逆回购。
summary.en: Caixin reported the finance ministry issued 150 billion yuan of special treasury bonds and the PBOC conducted 1.2 trillion yuan of outright reverse repos.
